note: SYNTHETIC test data generated by generate_synthetic_data.py. Not police data. Zone IDs are placeholders on an arbitrary grid, not real neighbourhood blocks or stages. Numbers are simulated and say nothing about any real place.

metadata.unit_of_observation: zone x calendar month (area-level, NOT street-level)
metadata.simulation_model: log(mu) = log(exposure_k_ped_hours) + b0 + b1*log1p(past_incidents) + b2*lighting_score + b3*hazard_reports + b4*isolation_score

columns.exposure_k_ped_hours: offset; simulated pedestrian activity in 1000 person-hours. Use log() as offset
columns.past_incidents: previous month's count in the same zone (lag-1, no leakage)
columns.hazard_reports: simulated count of open infrastructure reports
columns.true_mean: the mean the count was drawn from. Ground truth for checking only; never a model input

metadata.purpose: test the overdispersion check / Poisson vs Negative Binomial
